Three.js r170 (MIT, https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js, tag r170): build/three.module.min.js and
examples/jsm/{loaders/GLTFLoader,controls/OrbitControls,utils/BufferGeometryUtils}.js, unmodified except that the
"three" import is rewritten to the relative file so the 3D viewer works without a bundler or a CDN (site, app, offline).
Loaded only when someone opens a 3D model.
